title: Sly Moore
subtitle: Secretive Advisor
text: When Played: Take contol of an enemy token unit and ready it. At the start of the regroup phase, that token unit's owner takes control of it.
rules:
The delayed effect of Sly Moore's "When Played" ability remains active even if Sly Moore is defeated.
